pages.title: Jalsphire Dust
pages.text: The Jalsphire vein ended up giving me what remains of the gem it once was had, leaving me with this dust-like powder. I should combine the dusts I find into a pile and try smelting them together to see if that'll restore some semblance of the gem.
Crafting this will be not only a hassle to carry around carefully but also a mess if I haphazardly handle it.
And thus following this is the smelting process I should be able to recreate some copy of what the gem was.

pages.title: Smelt Jalsphire
pages.text: I should follow the instructions for myself so that I may continue my research.
